questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead has multiple turns and curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Traffic signals are always arranged the same way. Red is on top, yellow in the middle, and green on the bottom when vertical. Red is on the left and green on the right when horizontal.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a divided highway is beginning ahead. The road will split into separate one-way lanes with a median between them. Stay in the right lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns drivers that a four-way intersection is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Pennant-shaped signs are used only to mark no passing zones.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign has a red circle with a red slash through it, which means something is not allowed. Right turns are prohibited where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black text on a yellow background. They alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign means the divided highway will soon end.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Eight-sided signs mean you must stop. You must yield the right-of-way to other traffic. You may continue when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not permitted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drive with caution and be ready to slow down.
Do not drive in this lane.
You must come to a complete stop and yield the right-of-way.
Slow down, be prepared to stop, and, if necessary, yield the right-of-way.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down, be prepared to stop, and, if necessary, yield the right-of-way.
questions.explanation: Triangular signs mean yield. Slow down when you see this sign at an intersection. Be ready to stop and let other vehicles, cyclists, and pedestrians pass before you go.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for traffic on your right.
Don’t park on the right side of the street.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a slash means the action shown is not allowed. In this case, right turns are prohibited.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: No traffic is allowed in this lane.
You must merge into this lane.

questions.explanation: A solid green arrow pointing down means you can use that lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells drivers what they must and must not do. This sign means parking is not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Parking spaces are reserved for people with disabled parking permits.
Traffic in the lane must turn in the direction of the arrow.
Lanes are reserved for buses and vehicles with a driver and one or more passengers.

questions.correctAnswerText: Parking spaces are reserved for people with disabled parking permits.
questions.explanation: This sign marks parking spots for people who have disabled parking permits.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped and yellow with black letters or symbols. They alert drivers to hazards or special conditions ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells drivers what they must and must not do. This sign means left turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows that the road ahead is now divided. Stay to the right of the divider or median.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that pedestrians cross here. Watch for people in the crosswalk. Be ready to slow down or stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right at this intersection. Do not make a right turn where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Highway changes ahead and to the right.
Hiking trails ahead and to the right.
Hotel ahead and to the right.
Hospital ahead and to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Hospital ahead and to the right.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that a hospital emergency room is located to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a steep hill ahead.
No trucks are allowed on an upcoming hill.
There are trucks on an upcoming hill.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a steep hill ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep hill or downgrade is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a T intersection is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that an intersection with a crossing road is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must turn left or right.
You are approaching a T intersection.
The road that you are on intersects with a divided highway.
You are on an overpass above a divided highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road that you are on intersects with a divided highway.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that your road crosses a divided highway. A divided highway has two separate one-way roads divided by a median or guard rail.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: An upcoming curve in the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: An upcoming curve in the road.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead curves to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and prepare you for hazards ahead. This sign tells you that traffic may be coming toward you from the opposite direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Always stop, whether there’s a stop sign or not.
Watch for children and be ready to stop.
Always sound your horn when you see children.
Be ready to help children crossing the street.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: You must always yield to pedestrians in a crosswalk. Stay alert for pedestrians when driving through intersections or turning.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and prepare you for hazards ahead. This sign tells you that low clearance is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep hill is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: You can use hand signals instead of or along with turn signals. When your left arm is extended straight out to the left, it means you plan to turn left or change lanes to the left.
